STRATEGY / 5 MIN READ

Build and grow with one shared plan

Why your website and marketing work better when they start with the same goal.

EasyOra Editorial · Practical guide

Agree on one audience and one goal

A campaign and its landing page should speak to the same person about the same problem. Define the offer, the intended audience, and the next step before design or advertising begins.

Connect the message to the experience

Use consistent language from the campaign through to the website. If an advert promises a specific service, link to a page that explains that service and provides a relevant next step.

Make the next step clear

A visitor should understand what will happen after pressing a button or completing a form. Keep the requested information appropriate to the conversation and explain any follow-up process accurately.

Plan measurement before launch

Decide what a useful outcome looks like and which tools are appropriate. If tracking is added, plan privacy disclosures and any required consent alongside it. Do not collect information simply because a tool makes it possible.

Improve the whole journey

Review campaign quality and website experience together. If enquiries are not relevant, revisit the audience, offer, copy, and form. Test considered improvements and report what actually happened, rather than promising results.

Turn the ideas into a plan.
